sections.label: Opening
sections.action: Greet warmly, explain you will ask some questions about their loan application. Confirm their name.

fields.label: Full name as on Aadhaar
fields.ask: Aapka poora naam kya hai?

fields.label: Age
fields.ask: Aapki umar kitni hai?

fields.label: Family members
fields.ask: Ghar mein kul kitne log hain?

fields.label: Dependents (children, elderly)
fields.ask: Inmein se kitne bachche ya buzurg aap par nirbhar hain?

fields.label: Earning members in the household
fields.ask: Ghar mein aapke alawa aur kaun kamata hai?

fields.label: Monthly income of the other earners
fields.ask: Unki mahine ki kamai lagbhag kitni hai?

fields.label: Own house or rented
fields.ask: Ghar apna hai ya kiraye ka?

fields.label: How long at current address
fields.ask: Is ghar mein kitne saal se reh rahe hain?

fields.label: Monthly rent
fields.ask: Ghar ka kiraya mahine ka kitna dete hain?

fields.label: Type of business
fields.ask: Aap kya kaam karte hain?

fields.label: Years in business
fields.ask: Yeh kaam kitne saal se kar rahe hain?

fields.label: Shop or office location
fields.ask: Aapki dukaan ya kaam ki jagah kahan hai?

fields.label: Business premises owned or rented
fields.ask: Dukaan apni hai ya kiraye ki?

fields.label: Monthly rent of the business premises
fields.ask: Dukaan ka kiraya mahine ka kitna hai?

fields.label: Sole owner or partnership
fields.ask: Kaam aap akele chalate hain ya kisi ke saath milkar?

fields.label: Number of helpers or employees
fields.ask: Kaam mein kitne log madad karte hain?

fields.label: What they sell or do
fields.ask: Aap kya-kya bechte ya banate hain?

fields.label: Customers in a day
fields.ask: Roz lagbhag kitne grahak aate hain?

fields.label: Monthly sales or turnover
fields.ask: Mahine mein kul bikri kitni ho jaati hai?

fields.label: Monthly business expenses
fields.ask: Dukaan ka mahine ka kharcha kitna hai — kiraya, bijli, madadgar ki tankhwah milakar?

fields.label: Credit from suppliers
fields.ask: Maal udhaar par milta hai ya nakad dena padta hai?

sections.label: Business detail
sections.note: Extra questions for a walk-in. These numbers are what internal consistency is computed from, so without them a new applicant cannot be assessed at all.

fields.label: Average bill per customer
fields.ask: Ek grahak aam taur par kitne ka saamaan leta hai?

fields.label: Monthly stock or material purchase
fields.ask: Mahine mein kitne ka maal kharidte hain?

fields.label: Cash, UPI or credit split
fields.ask: Grahak zyada nakad dete hain ya UPI se?

fields.label: Best day's sales
fields.ask: Sabse achhe din kitni bikri hoti hai?

fields.label: Worst day's sales
fields.ask: Sabse halke din kitni bikri hoti hai?

fields.label: Main suppliers or distributors
fields.ask: Maal kahan se ya kis se lete hain?

fields.label: Udhaar given to customers
fields.ask: Grahakon ka kitna udhaar baaki hai abhi?

fields.label: Value of stock in the shop now
fields.ask: Abhi dukaan mein lagbhag kitne ka maal pada hai?

fields.label: How income changes by season
fields.ask: Saal mein kaunse mahine kaam zyada chalta hai, kaunse kam?

fields.label: Monthly income taken home
fields.ask: Sab kharcha nikaal kar mahine ki bachat ya kamai kitni hoti hai?

fields.label: Monthly household expenses
fields.ask: Ghar ka mahine ka kharcha kitna ho jaata hai?

fields.label: Running loans
fields.ask: Abhi koi loan chal raha hai — bank, finance company ya gold loan?

fields.label: Total monthly EMI
fields.ask: Sab kishton ko milakar mahine mein kitna jaata hai?

fields.label: Informal borrowing (committee, chit fund, moneylender, relatives)
fields.ask: Kisi committee, chit fund, sahukar ya rishtedaar se paisa liya hua hai?

fields.label: Any missed or late instalment before
fields.ask: Pehle kabhi koi kisht chhooti ya der se gayi?

fields.label: Which bank
fields.ask: Aapka khaata kis bank mein hai?

fields.label: Savings or FD
fields.ask: Kuch bachat hai — FD, RD ya committee mein?

fields.label: Other assets (land, house, vehicle, gold)
fields.ask: Aapke naam par kuch aur hai — zameen, makaan, gaadi ya sona?

sections.label: Document cross-check
sections.note: Verbal cross-check only. Nothing here is eKYC and the report must not imply it is.

fields.label: Aadhaar number
fields.ask: Apna Aadhaar number likh dijiye.

fields.label: PAN number
fields.ask: Apna PAN number likh dijiye.

fields.label: Address on the Aadhaar
fields.ask: Aadhaar par kaunsa pata likha hai?

fields.label: Does it match the current residence
fields.ask: Kya Aadhaar wala pata yahi hai jahan abhi rehte hain?

fields.label: PAN personal or firm
fields.ask: PAN card aapke naam ka hai ya dukaan/firm ke naam ka?

fields.label: Savings or current account
fields.ask: Khaata bachat wala hai ya current account?

fields.label: GST, Udyam or trade licence
fields.ask: Dukaan ka koi registration hai — GST, Udyam ya trade licence?

fields.label: Why they need the loan
fields.ask: Yeh paisa kis kaam mein lagayenge?

fields.label: How much they want
fields.ask: Kitne paise ki zaroorat hai?

fields.label: Own money going into the purpose
fields.ask: Is kaam mein apni taraf se kitna paisa lagayenge?

fields.label: How they plan to repay
fields.ask: Kisht kis kamai se bharenge? Koi mahina halka gaya toh kaise karenge?

tasks.label: Ask about landmarks, markets or civic detail in their area
Ask a trade question only a real owner would know

sections.label: Income recheck
sections.action: Ask about monthly earnings again in completely different words. Never say they were asked before.

sections.label: Closing
sections.action: Thank the borrower, say the officer will follow up. End warmly.
